# Wolraich et al. (1995): controlled sugar challenges and children's behaviour/cognition

Source: https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.1995.03530200053037

Abstract confirms 16 reports, 23 within-subject studies and 14 outcome constructs; weighted estimates range from -0.14 to +0.30 and all pooled 95% CIs include zero. Full outcome estimates, variances, individual study estimates and paired correlations not recovered. Do not replace missing estimates with zero or reconstruct intervals from significance alone.

External reference only; full-text/data redistribution rights not established. No source files are mirrored. The named research consumer is planned.
